title: Rename core/utils/date_utils.dart's DateUtils class off the Flutter SDK's own DateUtils name
rule: AG-4 (public top-level symbol names unique across lib/)
why: package:flutter/material.dart exports its own `abstract final class DateUtils` (src/material/date.dart:247, re-exported at material.dart:65) with methods like isSameDay/getDaysInMonth used elsewhere in this repo (e.g. monthly_activity_sliver_calendar.dart calls Flutter's DateUtils.getDaysInMonth). This project's core/utils/date_utils.dart declares a second, unrelated `class DateUtils` with different semantics (isSameLocalDay is deliberately UTC→local-day aware per the P5 streak-boundary pattern; Flutter's isSameDay is a raw field compare). At least 14 lib/ files and 25+ test files import both material.dart and this file unqualified; exactly one file (goal_setup_screen.dart:1) already needed `hide DateUtils` to compile because it calls the project's DateUtils.extractLocalDate. Any of the other ~39 files is one `DateUtils.` autocomplete away from either a hard "ambiguous import" compile error or — if an agent "fixes" it by hiding the wrong side — silently swapping in Flutter's timezone-naive comparison where the streak-safe local-day comparison was intended, a domain the whole file exists to get right.
recommendation: Rename the project's class (e.g. LocalDayUtils) or fold its 4 static methods into DateTimeFactory in the same file, so it no longer shadows the Flutter SDK name. Remove goal_setup_screen.dart's now-unnecessary `hide DateUtils` after the rename.
acceptance_criteria: `grep -rn "^class DateUtils" learning_tracker/lib/` returns no matches (class renamed).
goal_setup_screen.dart's `hide DateUtils` clause is removed and the file still compiles, confirming no remaining ambiguity.

corrections: The '25+ test files' claim is overstated: grepping test files that import both core/utils/date_utils.dart and unqualified 'package:flutter/material.dart' finds ~15, not 25+ (several other test importers use show-clauses that exclude DateUtils and are not actually at risk). Core mechanism and the one demonstrated instance remain accurate.
